law_name: Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK)
key_requirements: Expanded grounds for special-category data; tiered cross-border transfers (adequacy / SCCs notified to Board in 5 days / BCRs); VERBIS registration
notes: Amended by Law 7499 (in force 2024-06-01): new transfer regime, SCC notification, special categories
